notes: Tuition comes from the totals PDF. On the fees page, the tuition tables are images (prim-coll-lycee-2026-2027-1.png, option-*.png) that I could not read. In the PDF only the first table is titled ('Très petite section'). Tables 2-5 have no printed level title. Their order suggests Maternelle, Elémentaire, Collège, Lycée, but that is NOT confirmed, so I hedged the group labels. The three instalments ('payables en 3 versements', on 1 Sept / 1 Jan / 1 Apr) have no stated frequency, so their period is null. The company rows (+5%/+10%) are printed annual totals. The quotes were reconstructed from WebFetch output, which would not give the verbatim PDF text, so wording and formatting are approximate; the amounts are as extracted. The transport page states no year. The 2nd/3rd-child transport prices are in parentheses after the annual tariff, and it is unclear whether they are round-trip or one-way; I set period yearly from context. The DNL and Dance option amounts come from the PDF; I took 'per year' from WebFetch's reading. The fees page also mentions school supplies and option fees, but their amounts were only in images. The restaurant page has no prices. The clubs PDF had no machine-readable text. The daycare (garderie) page failed to fetch twice. A 2025-2026 inscriptions page exists, but I did not use older-year fees.
